topology_analysis.description: Two waveguides with 180-degree U-bends couple to a central straight bus via periodic Bragg gratings. Top waveguide enters from left, bends right 180deg, couples through grating teeth, exits left. Bottom waveguide mirrors this - enters from right, bends left 180deg, couples, exits right. Tapered tips at all four ports.
topology_analysis.function: Wavelength-selective coupling via Bragg reflection. Light in one waveguide contra-directionally couples to the other at the Bragg wavelength determined by grating period.
function_defining_knobs: gap_um - spacing between bus and curved guides
topology_analysis.geometry_notes: Footprint 18.24um appears to be the grating coupling region length. 0.7um is the waveguide width. Total device is wider due to the 180-degree bends on both sides.
